episodes.title: The Stick That Sang
episodes.doubles_moment: Kai grabs doubles from Mother Lall before heading to Carnival. Full bite. Eyes close. Deep breath. 'Full belly. Steady spirit.'
episodes.hook: Some sounds doh travel through air. Some travel through blood.
episodes.conflict: Kai is trying to have a normal Carnival night. A beat follows him that has no source.
episodes.reveal: Behind a vendor stall, an old bois waits like it has been listening for years. When Kai touches it, the street forgets how to breathe.
episodes.escalation: Every carving on the bois opens. Every rhythm turns toward Kai.
episodes.cliffhanger: And every piece of wood in the road answers.
episodes.narrator_script:
Some sounds doh travel through air. Some travel through blood.

In Trinidad, Carnival light wakes old roads, old houses, and old warnings.

Kai Baptiste had one plan tonight: grab doubles and gone.

Full belly. Steady spirit. That was his rule. But tonight, the rule failed.

A beat followed him through the crowd. No pan. No drum. No speaker. Just wood... calling his name.

Behind a vendor stall, an old bois waited like it had been listening for years.

When Kai touched it, the street forgot how to breathe. Every carving opened. Every rhythm turned toward him.

The elders called it a debt. The children called it a ghost. The stick called him by name.

And every piece of wood in the road answered.
episodes.caption_patois: The stick knew before he did. 🌿🥁 #OPAIJA #CaribbeanAnime #TrinidadAndTobago

episodes.title: The Gayelle Remembers
episodes.doubles_moment: Nia finds Kai at a doubles stall the morning after. He's eating two orders. Still shaken.
episodes.hook: The gayelle is not a ring. It is a memory.
episodes.conflict: Kai tries to return the bois. It won't leave him. Nia hears the lavway in the wood.
episodes.reveal: Papa Etienne is watching from a distance. He recognizes the Listening Bois.
episodes.escalation: He says only seven words: 'That stick chose last time two hundred years ago.'
episodes.cliffhanger: He turns and walks away. The bois pulses once.

episodes.title: Rootbreaker
episodes.doubles_moment: Malik sees Kai eating doubles across the gayelle. Lip curls. 'He eating before training? Dotish.'
episodes.conflict: Malik St. Hill hears about the Listening Bois choosing Kai. He challenges Kai publicly.
episodes.reveal: Malik is clearly the superior fighter technically. Kai barely holds on.
episodes.escalation: The Listening Bois responds to Kai's panic — a pulse that shakes the gayelle ground.
episodes.cliffhanger: Malik steps back. For the first time, something in his eyes is not contempt — it is calculation.
episodes.status_notes: Introduce Jabari drumming — test the Drum Sync visual language

episodes.title: The Lavway Doesn't Lie
episodes.doubles_moment: Nia sings a fragment of lavway while Kai eats doubles. The chickpea curry in the bara somehow makes the rhythm clearer to him. Comedy beat.
episodes.hook: Memory doesn't need a language. It needs a voice.
episodes.conflict: Nia attempts to teach Kai the first lavway. He cannot hear it properly — his Inner Pulse is unsteady.
episodes.reveal: Jabari picks up the rhythm on his drums without being asked. The lavway suddenly completes.
episodes.escalation: The first true Drum Sync between Kai and Jabari. Small but real.
episodes.cliffhanger: Somewhere across the city, a Silence Pulse ripples. Something heard them.
episodes.villain_presence: FELT — Silence Pulse in background, no face
episodes.status_notes: First introduction of Silence Pulse as a felt presence

episodes.title: Asha's Archive
episodes.doubles_moment: Asha has notes on doubles vendor routes across Trinidad in her research notebook. Kai is delighted and horrified that she mapped them.
episodes.hook: History does leave marks. Most people just stop looking.
episodes.conflict: Asha approaches the group with old maps and archive photographs. She knows what the Listening Bois is.
episodes.reveal: She shows them a photograph from 1885 — an elder holding what appears to be the same bois.
episodes.escalation: The bois in Kai's hand reacts to the photograph. A carving that wasn't there before appears.
episodes.cliffhanger: Asha looks at the carving, then at Kai. 'This means someone is coming. Someone old.'
episodes.location: Asha's research room / National Archives reference
episodes.status_notes: Introduce Asha's Memory Sight power subtly — she touches the photo and briefly sees

episodes.title: The Scout from the Sea
episodes.doubles_moment: Tariq arrives in Port of Spain. Stares at the doubles stall like he's never seen one. Kai is horrified. 'You never had doubles before?' First comedy beat between Kai and Tariq.
episodes.hook: Some people move like water. You don't see them until they're already past you.
episodes.conflict: A stranger from Tobago has been tracking the team. He arrives silently.
episodes.reveal: Tariq Davidson. He felt the Listening Bois awaken from across the sea.
episodes.escalation: He demonstrates Silent Beat — vanishes mid-conversation. Reappears behind Malik.
episodes.cliffhanger: He looks at Kai. 'The sea already moving. The silence moving faster. You ready?'
episodes.location: Port of Spain waterfront → doubles stall
episodes.status_notes: Full team assembled. Introduce all dynamics in one episode.

episodes.title: One Drum
episodes.doubles_moment: Kai reaches for doubles. Mother Lall stops him. Looks at him seriously. Wraps the doubles in paper and presses it into his hand. 'Take it with you. Don't eat it yet.' This is unusual. The team notices.
episodes.conflict: A young man in the gayelle collapses — his bois has gone silent. He cannot feel it anymore.
episodes.reveal: Asha recognizes the signs — Silence Pulse exposure. Someone used it here.
episodes.escalation: Tariq reads the tide on the wind. 'Came from the west. Deliberate.'
episodes.cliffhanger: FIRST SILHOUETTE OF MARIUS VALE. Back only. Standing on a hill above the city. A drum sits beside him. He does not turn.
episodes.CANON_NOTE: Marius Vale is back-only in this episode. No face. No voice. Silhouette only.

episodes.title: Blood of the Gayelle
episodes.doubles_moment: Kai eats the doubles Mother Lall gave him before entering the gayelle. Something in it tastes different. Focused.
episodes.hook: The gayelle does not care who you are. Only what you carry.
episodes.conflict: Kai enters an official gayelle match to prove the Listening Bois is real — not just a story.
episodes.reveal: Midway through the fight, his opponent's moves have something wrong — a slight Silence Pulse taint.
episodes.escalation: Kai finds the rhythm anyway. Wins. But barely. The crowd goes silent at the end — they felt something.
episodes.cliffhanger: In the crowd, a girl watches with cold eyes. She turns and walks away. SELAH VALE. First appearance.

episodes.title: Silence Has a Name
episodes.doubles_moment: Team is too tense for doubles. Kai goes anyway. Eats alone. Thinking. Mother Lall sits with him without speaking.
episodes.hook: The quietest thing in the room is always the most dangerous.
episodes.conflict: Asha identifies Selah Vale through archive photographs — daughter of a Guardian who vanished.
episodes.reveal: Selah approaches Nia alone. No threat. Just: 'Your lavway is wasted on them.'
episodes.escalation: Nia refuses. Selah smiles like she expected that.
episodes.cliffhanger: Selah's pendant glows — the same shape as Kai's. But inverted. Cold.

episodes.title: The False One Drum
episodes.doubles_moment: Kai cannot find a doubles vendor. Every stall near the event is closed. This unsettles him deeply. The team notices this is bad.
episodes.hook: Some men don't want to win. They want to erase.
episodes.conflict: A public gathering — a music event — is interrupted. Silence Pulse hits multiple people simultaneously.
episodes.reveal: MARIUS VALE. FULL FACE REVEAL. Elegant. Calm. Standing on stage.
episodes.escalation: 'Caribbean people scattered their rhythm for too long. I will gather it. All of it. Under one drum.'
episodes.cliffhanger: He looks directly at Kai in the crowd. 'I know what you carry, boy. And I know what it costs.'
episodes.CANON_NOTE: This is the full villain reveal. Treat with weight. Marius Vale is not shouting. He is certain.

episodes.title: What the Bois Remembers
episodes.doubles_moment: Papa Etienne brings doubles to the group himself. Old recipe. Stronger. 'My mother used to make this before a fight.' Weight in the room.
episodes.hook: The oldest things always know the most.
episodes.conflict: Kai demands answers from Papa Etienne. What IS the Listening Bois? Why him?
episodes.reveal: Papa Etienne tells the origin story — the sacred bois hidden in fragments, the ships, the lavway that survived. The real history.
episodes.escalation: The Listening Bois glows as Etienne speaks, as if confirming each word.
episodes.cliffhanger: Etienne: 'Marius was a Guardian too. Once.'
episodes.location: Papa Etienne's home — humble, old, filled with carved wood

episodes.title: The Gayelle Calls
episodes.doubles_moment: EXTENDED DOUBLES SCENE. Kai at Mother Lall's stall. She wraps six orders. Hands them to the whole team. First time everyone gets doubles together. Brief silence. Then Jabari: 'This is it, right?' Kai looks at the bois. 'This is it.'
episodes.hook: Some debts cannot wait. Some rhythms cannot be silenced.
episodes.conflict: Marius Vale issues a challenge through Selah — come to the gayelle or he deactivates all bois in Trinidad permanently.
episodes.reveal: The team discovers Malik has been training alone to fight Marius. He did not ask for help.
episodes.escalation: Kai and Malik — rival and rival — stand together at the gayelle entrance. No words. Just two bois.
episodes.cliffhanger: SEASON 1 CLIFFHANGER: The gayelle arena transforms. Marius Vale is already inside. 'I said one drum. I meant it.' The Silence Pulse begins. And somewhere, every drum in Trinidad goes quiet.
